title: CB-Orchestrator: Adaptive Workflow Optimization for LLM Agents via Contextual Bandits
title_zh: CB-Orchestrator：基于上下文多臂老虎机的 LLM Agent 自适应工作流优化
abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in tackling complex tasks through agentic workflows. However, manually designing these workflows is labor-intensive and lacks flexibility to adapt to diverse queries. While automated workflow optimization is a promising direction, existing methods often incur expensive API costs during training-phase feedback collection. Furthermore, they fail to adaptively reuse high-quality workflows, which creates a bottleneck for both performance and cost-effectiveness. To address these limitations, we propose CB-Orchestrator, an adaptive framework that decouples workflow generation from selection. In the first stage, we construct a diverse pool of candidate workflows via evolutionary search. In the second stage, we formulate workflow selection as a Contextual Bandit problem, which enables sample-efficient learning by balancing exploration and exploitation, thereby significantly reducing the feedback required for training. During inference, the model adaptively selects the optimal workflow tailored to each query. Evaluations across five diverse benchmarks demonstrate that CB-Orchestrator consistently outperforms all baselines. Notably, on the MATH dataset, CB-Orchestrator achieves better performance than strong recent baselines while reducing training-phase API token overhead by no less than 40.55% and total end-to-end training (including workflow pool generation) token overhead by no less than 29.73%.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）Agent 可通过智能体工作流解决复杂任务，但人工设计工作流成本高昂，且难以适应多样化查询。现有自动工作流优化方法通常需要在训练阶段收集大量反馈，产生高额 API 开销；同时，它们无法根据查询自适应地复用高质量工作流，限制了性能与成本效益。为此，本文提出 CB-Orchestrator，将工作流生成与选择解耦：第一阶段通过进化搜索构建多样化候选工作流池；第二阶段将工作流选择建模为上下文多臂老虎机（Contextual Bandit）问题，通过平衡探索与利用实现样本高效学习，显著减少训练所需反馈。推理时，模型可针对每个查询自适应选择最优工作流。五个不同基准上的实验表明，CB-Orchestrator 持续优于所有基线。在 MATH 数据集上，该方法不仅超越近期强基线，还将训练阶段的 API token 开销至少降低 40.55%，并将包含工作流池生成在内的端到端训练 token 总开销至少降低 29.73%。
key_points_zh: 提出 CB-Orchestrator，将候选工作流生成与面向查询的工作流选择解耦。
利用进化搜索构建多样化工作流池，使高质量工作流能够跨查询复用。
将工作流选择建模为 Contextual Bandit，通过探索—利用平衡减少训练反馈需求。
推理阶段根据查询上下文自适应选择最优工作流，在五个基准上持续优于基线。
在 MATH 上，训练阶段 API token 开销至少降低 40.55%，端到端训练 token 总开销至少降低 29.73%。

llm_assessment.comment: CB-Orchestrator offers a practical workflow-generation and contextual-selection architecture, although its benchmark evidence may favor generic prompt workflows over deep runtime orchestration.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: CB-Orchestrator提出了实用的工作流生成与上下文选择架构，但其实验可能更偏向通用提示工作流而非深层运行时编排。
